$comment: Ground truth for the recharts pack (docs/packs.md, "Ground truth"). Each public repository is pinned at the commit before its own Recharts 2 to 3 upgrade. Expected findings come from two sources that are not Uptide: the diagnostics the repository's TypeScript reports with recharts at the upgrade's version linked in and not without it, and the lines the upgrade commit changed (pnpm packs:truth, read by hand). One finding per place a person edits: diagnostics that share one cause are evidence of it and are not listed. In shadcn-ui/ui every copy of chart.tsx (seven) has one finding at the props type of ChartTooltipContent (the line the upgrade changed; its payload, label and implicit-any errors are evidence) and one at the Pick<LegendProps> of ChartLegendContent (its payload and length errors, and the TS2741 'payload is missing' error at the 21 <ChartLegend content={<ChartLegendContent />} /> sites, are evidence). Each Pie/Bar activeIndex plus activeShape or activeBar is one site, at the activeIndex line. A Cell import (TS6385 at the import) is evidence of the Cell element it imports. Left out on purpose: generated registry JSON under apps/v4/public/r, docs, and everything in either upgrade commit that is not about recharts (|| to ?? rewrites, key={index}, the reworked nearest-series tooltip in hyperdxio/hyperdx, tests that follow the code, the focus-ring CSS for accessibilityLayer, ResponsiveContainer initialDimension, partial margin objects gaining top and bottom, an e2e selector). Sites under 'generic' are breaks the 3.x declarations introduced that the 3.0 migration guide does not list (ReferenceArea SVG props, Bar layout, dataKey symbol, render function prop types), so no rule of the pack claims them. hyperdxio/hyperdx's packages/app cannot be compiled by check in this sandbox (its workspace packages are not built, scripts off: 22 of 33 files cannot resolve their imports), so the compiler-visible sites there are false negatives of the engine's compile signal, not of a rule. The Yarn lockfile of hyperdxio/hyperdx resolves ^3.2.1 to 3.9.1. Both repositories install at their root: check cannot install a workspace subdirectory whose lockfile is at the repository root.

repos.why: the component registry behind shadcn/ui charts: seven copies of the ChartContainer, ChartTooltipContent and ChartLegendContent wrappers over recharts, and about forty chart demos with Pie and Bar activeIndex, Cell, custom tooltip and legend content, custom dots, ticks and labels
